UsageNow Support

Help with direct provider connections, status codes, your data, and the one-time lifetime purchase.

Troubleshooting and account care

  • Connection types

    A provider may use an API or admin key supplied by you, or an OAuth or device authorisation flow when the provider officially supports it. Every refresh goes directly to documented official provider endpoints. UsageNow never asks for your password, imports browser cookies, scrapes dashboard HTML, calls private endpoints, or bypasses rate limits. Available fields vary by provider and account plan.

  • 401 — Unauthorised

    The credential is missing, expired, revoked, or belongs to the wrong service. Create or renew it in the provider's official console, grant only the minimum requested permission, then replace the credential or choose Sign In Again. Never email the key.

  • 403 — Forbidden

    The provider recognized the credential, but the account may lack a required scope, billing role, team or organisation access, or SSO approval. Confirm the account target and the provider's minimum read permission. Some plans do not expose usage data.

  • 404 — Not found

    Check the exact organisation, team, workspace, username, or resource identifier. A 404 can also mean the provider does not expose that usage endpoint for your plan or region. Follow the current in-app official connection guide; never substitute a private endpoint.

  • Offline, stale, or rate limited

    UsageNow keeps the last saved snapshot with its timestamp. Reconnect and try a bounded refresh later. For 429 or provider maintenance, wait for the official retry window; repeated requests do not bypass a provider limit.

  • Data Management

    Export creates a file on this device only when you ask and opens an Apple destination picker; credentials and raw provider responses are excluded. Delete all data removes the local repository, Keychain credentials, App Group and Widget cache, Apple Watch payload, private CloudKit records, and trial anchor. A non-identifying CloudKit deletion generation remains only to stop an offline device from restoring deleted content. Delete exported files and Apple-managed backups separately.

  • Restore Purchase

    Full access lasts three days from the first saved live snapshot. After that, existing saved information remains as a dated read-only preview until a single non-consumable lifetime purchase is verified. StoreKit displays the current local price. Use Restore while signed in to the Apple Account that made the purchase. There is no subscription or automatic renewal.

  • Send a safe support report

    Send the device model, operating system and app version, provider name used only as a compatibility label, connection method, status code, approximate time, and a non-secret diagnostic event code if shown. Never send a token, password, cookie, slug, full URL, request body, response body, or header. The developer cannot recover credentials or provider data.

  • Independent compatibility

    These names are used only to identify compatible services: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google/Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, xAI/Grok, OpenRouter. UsageNow is independent and is not endorsed, sponsored, or affiliated with those providers.

Contact UsageNow support

Include your device model, Apple operating system and app version, provider compatibility name, connection method, status code, and approximate time. Never send an access token, password, cookie, organisation or workspace slug, full URL, request or response body, or headers.
